data_scope.note: 49 previously opened frames are exposed diagnostic/development-adjacent data; not a sealed test for future tuning

code_checks.image_decoding: cv2.imread IMREAD_GRAYSCALE; no RGB/BGR color path in matching
code_checks.resize_crop: no image crop/resize/letterbox; only template resizing
code_checks.anchor_mapping: bbox top-left + anchor_fraction * scaled template size
code_checks.bbox_origin: top-left pixel, same as PIL labels
code_checks.angle_convention: atan2(px - cx0, fx); positive image-right; not world bearing
code_checks.frames: image projection only; camera optical frame vs body frame not mixed in bearing

hypotheses.hypothesis: baseline bbox center and label green light reference are the same physical bearing object
hypotheses.experiment: coordinate_audit rows: label bbox center vs green; accepted baseline bbox center vs label center and green
hypotheses.observation: label bbox-center vs green angle 0.28-5.06 deg; baseline center vs label-center 5.65-11.74 deg; baseline center vs green 9.13-11.46 deg; baseline has no physical anchor
hypotheses.scope_effect: old baseline green-bearing values are historical and not directly comparable to green-anchor bearing; retain old numbers but do not call them physical anchor errors

hypotheses.experiment: image/intrinsic consistency; synthetic anchor mapping at scales 0.5/0.8/1.0; B reproduction; code path review
hypotheses.observation: all 49 images 320x240 with fx=160/cx0=160; synthetic anchor tests pass at .5/.8/1.0; B new code + old template + old .55 reproduces 613 frame statuses exactly; no crop/letterbox; anchor = bbox top-left + fraction*scaled template size
hypotheses.scope_effect: no coordinate constant correction; retain old freeze; anchor mapping itself is not evidence for improved localization because correct candidate absent

hypotheses.hypothesis: threshold .65 alone causes improved zero recall and lowering the threshold fixes it
hypotheses.experiment: improved threshold sweep; target-overlap candidate scores for the nine bbox-labelled positives
hypotheses.observation: at .55 TP15/FP22, .60 TP4/FP20, .65 TP0/FP2; 4 target candidates below .65, 5 very low; no threshold gives acceptable precision/recall; lowering accepts many hard negatives
hypotheses.status: PARTIALLY_CONFIRMED (threshold is a secondary gate, not root cause)
hypotheses.scope_effect: do not tune threshold on exposed data; threshold alone cannot recover independent view performance

hypotheses.hypothesis: development-only templates do not cover reverse/north/oblique target appearance; score selection prefers background/other structures
hypotheses.experiment: per-template ablation; template selection histogram; template texture stats; target-overlap score; wrong-candidate boxes
hypotheses.observation: center template dominates 43/49, left 0/49, route 6/49; center alone at .65 TP0/FP2; left alone TP0; route alone TP0/FP0/.55 FP4; global max often IoU 0-0.2 on non-target regions at score .55-.61; target-best often .34-.59
hypotheses.scope_effect: template method not robust across independent views; adding more same-scene templates is not justified

hypotheses.experiment: target bbox width/height vs max template extent; extra diagnostic scales 1.3/1.5/1.8/2.0
hypotheses.observation: target width ratio up to 1.82x template max; extra scales raise north s192 target score .485->.627 and north s186 .528->.554, but reverse stays .34-.43 and still below .65; static remains .589
hypotheses.status: PARTIALLY_CONFIRMED (contributor for north; not sole for reverse)
hypotheses.scope_effect: scale is a capability limit, not a single index bug; do not adopt a narrow scale patch as success

hypotheses.experiment: formal results status by test frame; gate status counts
hypotheses.observation: all 49 diagnostic frames have consumer results; test frames show 0 UNKNOWN/0 REJECTED; rejects are warmup only
hypotheses.scope_effect: zero improved recall is detector/candidate/threshold, not gate suppression

hypotheses.hypothesis: NCC scores from different templates are comparable/calibrated as a single confidence
hypotheses.experiment: per-template selection histogram, per-template threshold sweeps, wrong background matches
hypotheses.observation: same NCC metric but center dominates; other templates never selected; wrong regions score .55-.61; no calibration or score normalization beyond the shared NCC definition
hypotheses.status: REJECTED as calibrated score; CONFIRMED as score-selection failure mode
hypotheses.scope_effect: do not call score probability; multi-template max is not a validated confidence

hypotheses.hypothesis: the 49 opened frames can be reused as a sealed independent test after diagnosis
hypotheses.observation: the 49 frames have already been opened and used for diagnosis; labels and candidate distributions are now visible
hypotheses.scope_effect: 49 frames are diagnostic/exposed only; future tests require new trajectory families and fresh freeze

method_decision.implementation_defect: NONE_CONFIRMED; B reproduces baseline, coordinate synthetic tests pass; no production code fix made
method_decision.threshold_or_template_patch: NOT_RECOMMENDED; no acceptable threshold operating point; adding more same-scene templates is an unbounded coverage chase
method_decision.next_method: classical tower geometry + green-light anchor detector (edges/contour/trapezoid + HSV green blob + relative-position validation), no learned model, output bbox and anchor bearing only
method_decision.next_validation_cost: freeze new parameters; 3-4 new independent GUI episodes (reverse/north/oblique/away), 40-60 labelled frames; offline CPU evaluation; no Isaac retraining; no test-time threshold tuning
method_decision.stop_condition: if geometry+green anchor still cannot meet predeclared IoU/bearing with acceptable hard-negative FP, stop perception work this phase and do not add templates
